name: Kessig
description: Kessig is a rugged, rural province of Innistrad in perpetual autumn, with human villages amid haunted forests and many werewolves.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Kessig is a rugged, rural province of Innistrad in perpetual autumn, with human villages amid haunted forests and many werewolves.

bio.text: Humans moved in, named it Kessig, felled trees, planted crops and prayed to angels against the forest's evils.

citations.text: "Kessig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When Avacyn went missing, the church at Thraben concealed the truth while werewolf attacks and hauntings increased, and the Curfew of Silver required blessed silver amulets for commoners after dark.

bio.text: Arlinn Kord, who hails from Kessig, was drawn into Tovolar's pack as a teenager and later abandoned it after refusing his demand to slaughter foresters.

bio.text: Arlinn, Kaya, Teferi and Chandra traveled to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods, and at the Celestus Arlinn joined the key to the Sungold Lock, so that the sun rose over Innistrad for the first time in months.

timeline.summary: Humans move into the area, name it Kessig, fell trees, plant crops and pray to angels against forest evils.
timeline.quote: But then humans moved into the area and named it Kessig, felling trees and planting crops and praying to the angels to keep the evils of the forest at bay.

citation.text: "Kessig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's return strengthens wards and blessings in Kessig but does not eliminate the Ulvenwald's horrors.
timeline.quote: Avacyn's return strengthened the wards and blessings, but it did not eliminate the horrors of the Ulvenwald.

citation.text: "Kessig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn goes missing, and the church at Thraben conceals the truth while werewolf attacks and hauntings increase.
timeline.quote: Ever since Avacyn went missing last year, the church at Thraben has kept the truth of her disappearance from Innistrad's denizens.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Curfew of Silver decree requires blessed silver amulets for Kessig commoners after dark; relations with Gavony worsen.
timeline.quote: Since the Curfew of Silver, relations between Kessig and Gavony have worsened.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As a teenager Arlinn is summoned by Tovolar's pack's howls and completes her First Hunt.
timeline.quote: Arlinn was a teenager from Avabruck when the howls of Tovolar 's Mondronen werewolf pack summoned her into the forest and she completed her First Hunt.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn rejects Tovolar's urging to slaughter foresters, fights him and abandons the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn rejected that idea and fought Tovolar, leaving lasting scars on them both.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, making evacuation from Kessig's villages difficult.
timeline.quote: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.

citation.text: Gnarlwood Dryad (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arlinn walks through a frozen Kessig village, noting that sundown comes sooner and sooner.
timeline.quote: Sundown comes sooner and sooner.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sits with Agatha, whose husband was killed, and promises to investigate the murders.
timeline.quote: even now as she tells his wife that she'll do her best to investigate these murders

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Agatha tells Arlinn that a witch is making effigies to help the village.
timeline.quote: That's the witch's doing.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls sparing a white stag and finding a skull left by Tovolar the next morning (flashback).
timeline.quote: there was a skull before them, resting atop a sword driven into the ground

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn's wolves lead her along carved boughs toward the witches' enclave.
timeline.quote: A series of crescents and rounds line it, shaped by a careful hand.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: A rough, deep howl interrupts them, and Arlinn recognizes it as Tovolar's.
timeline.quote: A howl, rough and deep.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Six arrive in the Kessig forest near where they first met.
timeline.quote: put their massive foot down on the soil of Innistrad, deep within the Kessig forest

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn uproots herself from Six, who becomes an oak, ending their partnership.
timeline.quote: she uprooted herself and was no longer joined with Six

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn promises to return someday to find Six and offer his acorns the same choice.
timeline.quote: I will walk these woods again, and I will find you, old friend

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn wanders the forest following treesong toward a possible new partner.
timeline.quote: following the whisper of treesong that told her there was a viable partner growing here

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
timeline.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains a fire devoured her people's trees until she pulled it into herself, where it still burns.
timeline.quote: It devoured the trees of my people, until I found a way to pull it into myself.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
timeline.quote: Then we walk.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
timeline.quote: We're being followed,

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
timeline.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
timeline.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
timeline.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
timeline.quote: They call me Wrenn.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
timeline.quote: I will trust you for now.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
timeline.quote: We've made a big loop.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
timeline.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
timeline.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
timeline.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn walks to an oak and dives into it, finding the sapling that sang to her.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was walking, step by unsteady step, toward that tree.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The tree unfolds into a slumbering treefolk with Wrenn joined to its chest.
timeline.quote: it unfolded into the model of a man, a slumbering treefolk in the process of waking

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
timeline.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
timeline.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi, alone, returns to the village having gained a lesson and a new ally.
timeline.quote: For the first time since entering these woods, Teferi was alone.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn, after her first change, sits with Tovolar, who tells her the woods belong to them; she suggests they could share them with the Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "These woods belong to us," he told her.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn shifts into a wolf and runs after Tovolar and her wolves, answering his howl.
timeline.quote: She shifts before she knows what she's doing

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers hearing Tovolar's howl as a girl and leaving her walled-in village at night for a life without fear.
timeline.quote: Under cover of night, she left.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Tovolar surrounded by huge wolves who have changed early, and asks who the newcomers are.
timeline.quote: "Who are these guys?"

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Tovolar shows young Arlinn three torn-apart hunters and tells her that being free is worth whatever it costs.
timeline.quote: "Being free is worth whatever we pay for it," he answered.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sees that the wolves gathered around Tovolar are a new pack, not his old Mondronen one, and that something bigger than a hunt is being prepared.
timeline.quote: "Family," he answers. "Our new pack."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar reveals he is getting ready to take the nights as well as the woods, hunting vampires and anyone else.
timeline.quote: "Getting ready to take what's ours," he says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn refuses to accept that wolves can do whatever they want, and Tovolar scorns her for having too much church in her.
timeline.quote: "Too much church in you," he growls. "Too little wolf."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn comes home to her mother, who says four boys were found torn apart in the woods, and Arlinn cannot bring herself to tell the truth.
timeline.quote: "Where were you?" she creaked.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn wakes after a hunt with a bolt-wound healed and the bodies of the village kids, now hunters, around her, and screams.
timeline.quote: Her mouth was slick with their blood.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn raises a claw to strike Tovolar to delay his plans, but Boulder jumps in front of him and she pulls back.
timeline.quote: But before it can make contact, Boulder's in motion, jumping in front of him.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder side with Tovolar, and Arlinn sees that her wolves want to hunt.
timeline.quote: Streak joins him. So does Redtooth.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Arlinn finds refuge in the church, where friends help her feel safe, until Tovolar comes to morning services and sits beside her.
timeline.quote: Until he showed up to morning services.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn locks herself in her room with holy symbols, but it is not enough, and she wakes elsewhere with the memory of blood.
timeline.quote: Arlinn locked herself in her room that night

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Patience to join Tovolar so she can stay with the wolves and keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Keep everyone safe," she says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to find him when she is ready for the new world and begins to shift; she leaves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar nods. "When you're ready for the new world, come find us."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Katilda and agrees to get the key; Katilda welcomes her to the fire without remarking on the missing wolves.
timeline.quote: "I'll get your key," she says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At first light Katilda and her witches cast a calling for the coven's chosen champions while Arlinn sneaks off to Ravnica to find help.
timeline.quote: she sneaks off to Ravnica.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
timeline.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
timeline.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move, while the festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope but more people go missing.
timeline.quote: Leinore found the dead snake mixed in the ashes of a campfire gone cold hours ago.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At an abandoned tent of a missing family, Sinnia finds a scale-crusted golden mask and tries it on over Leinore's objections.
timeline.quote: Sinnia took off her fox mask and tried on the new one, causing Leinore to flinch.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: That night Sinnia, still masked, tells Leinore that the Coiled One has spoken to her and is surfacing.
timeline.quote: The Coiled One has spoken to me today, sister.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn remembers that after two years under Tovolar's tutelage she left him scarred and bleeding and ran away in the night.
timeline.quote: she left him scarred and bleeding then ran away in the middle of the night

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn recalls the night she challenged Tovolar for the alpha position and the scar she gave him.
timeline.quote: And then she'd be the alpha of the howlpack.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to a mass human hunt; she refuses and tries to attack him, and her wolves side with Tovolar.
timeline.quote: Tovolar invites Arlinn to join him and other werewolves in a massive human hunt in Kessig .

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Humans gather deep in the woods of the Kessig countryside amid werewolves and other night denizens.
timeline.quote: there's strength and hope for the humans gathered deep in the woods of the Kessig countryside.

citation.text: "Innistrad: Midnight Hunt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: York sees crows in Kessig and nervously insists they are not an omen.
timeline.quote: No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think.

citation.text: Winged Portent (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Kessig villager says his wolfrider partner protects the village and eats captured vampires.
timeline.quote: My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch.

citation.text: Kessig Wolfrider (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Just after the girls turn fifteen, their parents are attacked in the woods and killed.
timeline.quote: their parents were attacked in the woods and killed

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The coming of the Whisperers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Willia is allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor.
timeline.quote: Willia was allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The coming of the Whisperers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda attacks the Lord of the Manor with a rusty pick; Davriel brushes it off and decides to help her.
timeline.quote: attempted to kill him with a rusty pick

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Meeting Davriel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda and Davriel reason that the Whisperers come from the Bog.
timeline.quote: Davriel reasoned that they were from the Bog

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity, but the Bog is empty and they are besieged by Whisperers.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Willia accidentally kills her parents with the stone's power and turns them into Whisperers.
timeline.quote: turned them into Whisperers

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The truth revealed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda finds the Nameless Angel's body, whose soul encourages a new song, and she defeats and absorbs the Whisperers.
timeline.quote: Tacenda managed to defeat the Whisperers and absorb their souls

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Davriel's help Tacenda overcomes and kills Willia, and the Bog Entity is made whole inside Tacenda.
